summary: Frontend E2E validation of the redesigned two-control-per-course UI in the custom (مخصص) workload report builder. All requested flows PASS: each course row renders with a checkbox (checked by default) and a purple '✓ ضمن النصاب' pill; unchecking strikes through the name (line-through, grey #94a3b8) and hides the pill; re-checking restores the pill reset to '✓ ضمن النصاب' (even after being إضافي before uncheck); pill toggles to amber '⏱ إضافي بالكامل' and back; hint line updates live ('2 من 3 مقرر مُدرج ... 1 منها إضافي بالكامل ... 1 مقرر غير مُحدَّد سيختفي تماماً'). CRITICAL: with 'لغة إنجليزية - اختبار' unchecked, the request sent course_ids=[2 ids], excluded_course_ids=[حضرموت]; the sheet showed only 'مقرر اختبار 180156' and 'دراسات حضرموت' (English absent). The حضرموت row note says 'مقرر مُستثنى لهذا التقرير فقط — لا يُحتسب من النصاب'. Edge case all unchecked: request sent ['__none__'], the sheet row shows '—' / 'لا مقررات' with النصاب 0.0. Second entry of the same teacher works independently (only English selected -> 1 course row). Remove entry works. PDF (application/pdf) and Excel (spreadsheetml) return 200 with the same payload; the Excel content check confirms English is absent. The standard tab (قياسي) renders normally.

issues: A course marked 'إضافي بالكامل' (excluded from load) still shows a value in النقص (e.g. 9.0) and 0% نسبة الإنجاز highlighted pink. That can confuse users because an excluded course should have no shortage. This is a minor UX/semantic point and not part of this redesign.
Entry note says 'نصاب 2 مقرر مختار' while one of the 2 is excluded from load. Consider counting only the load-included courses in that phrase.

action_items: Optional: hide or blank the النقص and نسبة الإنجاز cells for courses marked إضافي بالكامل in the custom sheet, and adjust the 'نصاب N مقرر مختار' note to count only load-included courses.
critical_code_review_comments: toggleCustomInclude correctly removes the course from excludedIds when unchecking. runCustom/downloadCustom filter excluded_course_ids to included ids and use the '__none__' sentinel. Logic is sound.
Changing the date range after adding entries does not re-fetch each entry's course list. This is existing behavior; consider refreshing entries or warning the user.
